prompts.title: Traditional South Indian Lifestyle Photography
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a stylish man standing at the entrance of the veranda of a traditional Kerala heritage house. He has naturally styled hair, and wears dark rectangular sunglasses. He is dressed in a mustard-yellow full-sleeve cotton shirt, paired with a traditional off-white Kerala mundu/dhoti featuring a subtle golden border.
He stands casually in the entrance of the veranda, body facing slightly toward the camera, with his left hand resting naturally against a wooden pillar while his other arm hangs relaxed by his side. He looks directly at the camera with a calm, confident, and composed expression.
The setting is an authentic old Kerala ancestral house (nalukettu-inspired architecture) with weathered dark wooden pillars, a traditional aged clay-tiled roof, wooden doors, rustic veranda railings, and a vintage chair partially visible in the background. Lush green tropical foliage surrounds the house, with soft out-of-focus leaves in the foreground creating beautiful natural framing.
Lighting: Golden-hour sunlight streams in from the upper-left side, softly illuminating the man’s face, mustard shirt, and wooden pillars. Warm golden highlights, subtle natural contrast, and cinematic atmospheric depth.
Composition: full-body environmental portrait, subject centered, eye-level camera angle, symmetrical architectural framing, foreground foliage creating depth, slightly shallow depth of field, realistic background separation.
Photography: cinematic editorial photography, natural earthy color palette, warm muted tones, realistic skin texture, detailed hair strands, authentic fabric texture, highly detailed wood and architecture, soft bokeh, natural shadows, subtle film grain, 85mm lens, f/2.0, professional color grading, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution. Aspect ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: Beautiful Radha Portrait with Floral Jewelry and Flute
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
Create a photorealistic cinematic portrait of a beautiful woman dressed as a graceful divine-inspired Indian flute musician, centered in a vertical composition. She has smooth, glowing skin, subtle makeup, and a slight natural blush on her cheeks, voluminous smooth hair flowing naturally over her shoulders, adorned with delicate floral hair jewelry and a single elegant peacock feather. The subject is dressed in a traditional pastel blue lehenga set adorned with intricate gold embroidery—the blouse richly detailed with fine gold patterns, paired with a flowing matching skirt and a sheer dupatta draped elegantly over the arms. Delicate white-and-pink floral jewelry decorates her neck, wrists, upper arm, and ears. Elegant white traditional face art is painted across her forehead and around her eyes. She gently holds a polished wooden bansuri flute diagonally across her chest with both hands, standing with her body slightly angled while looking directly into the camera with a soft, and graceful smile.
Background: dreamy studio backdrop with a smooth cyan-blue glow on the left transitioning into warm peach-pink on the right, subtle atmospheric haze and soft bokeh.
Lighting: Cinematic soft beauty lighting, a slightly warm rim light from the right, gentle highlights on the hair and skin, and natural skin tones.
Composition: medium-to-three-quarter portrait, subject centered, flute clearly visible, flowing hair creating elegant framing, shallow depth of field.
Camera: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, soft background separation, high dynamic range, cinematic color grading, ultra-detailed skin and fabric textures, photorealistic, 8K resolution, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.
Negative prompt: distorted hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, bad anatomy, deformed face, unnatural eyes, plastic skin, duplicate objects, blurry subject, identity change.
